notes.subject: kopa
notes.rationale: נחשת em i kopa (copper), no 'stil' olsem KJV

notes.subject: Barrett bilong hap nort
notes.rationale: Tok hia i min strong tru — samting i no inap brokim; em i tok bilong bainat bilong birua bilong hap nort

notes.subject: כלה מקללוני — ves 10 i wok wantaim ves 12
notes.rationale: Sampela i tingting ves 12 i tok long birua bilong hap nort (Babilon) we i strong olsem Barrett — no Jeremia

translation: Inap man brokim Barrett — Barrett bilong hap nort, na kopa?
